## Overview

The Flesh Architects' primary research facility — the main installation where the most sensitive Covenant research is conducted, including the Catalyst Project and Project Genesis. Located east-southeast of Gamma-7 (partial map coordinates recovered from Gamma-7's Records Office).

## Key Facts

- The facility Zan escaped from at age 13
- Larger and more important than Gamma-7
- Houses both Catalyst Project and Project Genesis research
- Zan was scheduled for transfer TO Gamma-7 FROM this facility — the transfer was never completed because he escaped
- The facility is active, unlike the decommissioned Gamma-7
- Sophie (Subject 241) may still be held here

## Current Status

Active and operational. Coordinates are classified. The party has a partial map showing the general direction (east-southeast from Gamma-7).

## GM Notes

The Primary Facility serves as a future campaign location. Its defenses, personnel, and specific location are not yet defined — they should be developed when the party is ready to approach it.
